entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Let's see... The reservation comes[n]first. You remember that restaurant[n]Chief told you about?

entries.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper
entries.en: Thank you for calling, sir. Were you[n]looking to make a reservation?
A table for two on the 14th.

entries.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper
entries.en: I'm sorry, sir, but I'm afraid we're fully[n]booked for tomorrow.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: But don't worry, [fName]! All you[n]have to do is mention the chief!
I'm a friend of Sojiro Sakura.
Sojiro Sakura told me to call.

entries.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper
entries.en: Y-You're a friend of Mr. Sakura's!?

entries.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper
entries.en: My apologies, sir! If you could just hold[n]for one moment...

entries.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper
entries.en: Thank you for your patience. You wanted[n]a dinner course for two on the 14th?

entries.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper
entries.en: We will have a table ready for you.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Dang! The chief has serious clout!

entries.speaker: Friendly Shopkeeper
entries.en: Could I ask your name and contact[n]information?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Okay, your dinner plans are locked in.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Now you just gotta get the flowers, and[n]then it's off to the aquarium and dinner!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's gonna be busy tomorrow, so we'd[n]better get rest while we can.
